survivors.claim: D17 promises colorFor keeps resolving FOUR roles distinctly, but the new AC-20260912-12-22 only pins two of them behaviourally (open -> rgb(220,38,38), addressed -> rgb(217,119,6)). The resolved (--v-ok) and outdated/withdrawn (--v-muted) halves are carried only by a source grep of viewer.css's comment block, which cannot detect a colorFor change. A future collapse of resolved onto open would pass this AC.
survivors.evidence: Spec lines 318-326 name only open and addressed computed colours plus the comment-block grep. The AC-22 test body asserts exactly openBg === 'rgb(220, 38, 38)', addressedBg === 'rgb(217, 119, 6)' and a notStrictEqual between them; the only coverage of --v-ok/--v-muted is assert.match over the CSS comment, not over colorFor. Impact: half of the owner's colour ruling is guarded by a comment check rather than by what the screen paints.
